root_owner_goal: Source-defined chart interpretations evaluated prospectively on untouched, consenting people with concealed and frozen predictions, matched decoys and nonastrology controls

official_source.source_critical_finding: Same numerical line has different sequence/sphere-specific keywords. Generic six-line interpersonal guidance does NOT identify a primary natal sphere or a quantified probability.

branch.line_definition: Incumbent verified Human Design Rave Mandala natal Sun 1..6, at exact/uncertain birth interval
branch.original_publishers_six_lines: Original source 'responds best to' language, but no behavioral rating scale is supplied.

proposed_primary_test.endpoint: In each of four fictional neutral scenarios, choose the one message you would personally most prefer to receive; compare chosen style against pre-frozen natal Sun Line's mapped style
proposed_primary_test.matched_data_clustering: Shuffle entire subject line assignments among subjects within declared strata; NEVER individual responses across repeated scenarios
proposed_primary_test.base_rate_control: Person-level permutation preserves population preferences for practical/gentle messages and all four scenario effects; NEVER use uniform 1/6 alone as the inferential null
proposed_primary_test.predicted_choice_per_person: The Line number 1..6 -> corresponding style; exactly one selected primary Sphere natal Sun; cannot choose among other 10 spheres after results
proposed_primary_test.test_statistic: Total (source Line-matched choices)/eligible four-task responses; exact source-line assignment null against matched strata
proposed_primary_test.non_astrology_comparator: Population base style preference rates plus demographic strata and season of birth, pre-specified before people respond
proposed_primary_test.unavoidable_hd_shared_input: Gene Keys natal Sun Line is numerically IDENTICAL to Human Design natal Sun Line. Therefore no feature-level incremental information beyond the full HD input can ever be established solely by this mapping.
proposed_primary_test.possible_valid_incremental_comparison: Compare specific frozen Gene Keys interpretation to a separately frozen Human Design semantic forecast on identical inputs and outcomes; any difference is interpretation, not independent coordinates
